card.text: Explore 209P/LINEAR through a shape approximation constrained by radar observations.

introduction.text: LINEAR releases very little gas for a comet of its size. Its close approach in 2014 let Arecibo measure the nucleus through the surrounding dust.

model.title: Radar dimensions
model.summary: A smooth approximation of LINEAR’s published radar dimensions. The measurements constrain its size, but do not supply a detailed surface model. The grid marks absent surface photographs; the orientation is illustrative.
